Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

precise surgery.

most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

precise surgery.

Engineering the

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and

complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

Microsoft grows market share

Enterprise share continues rising

[OpenAI icon]

OpenAI releases new AI model

Reasoning and multimodality improved

[Stripe icon]

Stripe closes Bridge acquisition

Expands stablecoin infrastructure

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

## Frequently Asked Questions

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

Extract custom insights, like buyer lists or valuation sentiment, via MCP or the native AI chatbot.

sales ratio.

03.

We split comps into 220+ granular categories across all industry verticals, with a special emphasis
on digital ecosystems. You can filter through tech themes like vertical AI applications or IoT as
well as compare to offline sectors like airlines or logistics.

[See more on sectors][12]

Multiples is an absolute game-changer and saved me countless hours of analysis. User-friendly UI,

[Adam Hajer]

Adam Hajer

Investor at Russmedia

[Sector Classification Built For Digital Age]

workflows, or build your own financial SaaS products powered by our data - significantly cheaper

[See API documentation][13]

With the most comprehensive tech-first company taxonomy I've seen for public markets, Multiples.vc
allowed us to bring the data to life for the State of European Tech Report readers.

Hanna-Stina Sonts

VP at Atomico

[Automate Valuation Workflows With API]

## Doesn't Need To Be Painful

Our mission: to deliver institutional-quality valuation data through a modern UI at a fraction of

Native AI copilot continously trained on our dataset, so you can extract custom insights in seconds.

Automate your Google Sheets and Excel valuation workflows, or build your own tools using our
[API][15].

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

### Pacemaker

Create your mix in a heartbeat with Pacemaker for iPhone, Apple Watch and iPad. Just pick your
tracks or playlist from iTunes or Spotify and…Boom!

Instant mix magic!

Pick your tracks or playlist from millions of songs included in Pacemaker and let our artificial
intelligence DJ empower you to create a mix masterpiece. When done, share it with friends and a
community of music lovers! Pacemaker provides an easy to use DJ app for all DJs and gives you
instant access to millions of tracks and a simple sync to your Spotify and Apple Music playlists.
You can create mixes by selecting track by track or simply pick a playlist and let our AI DJ
(Automix) create a perfect seamless mix for you. If you want to edit your mix in detail, enter the
studio: Zoom in and crop the beginning and the end of tracks, set the mix on more precise levels –
phrase, bar and beat.

### Pacemaker

Create your mix in a heartbeat with Pacemaker for iPhone, Apple Watch and iPad. Just pick your
tracks or playlist from iTunes or Spotify and…Boom!

Instant mix magic!

Pick your tracks or playlist from millions of songs included in Pacemaker and let our artificial
intelligence DJ empower you to create a mix masterpiece. When done, share it with friends and a
community of music lovers! Pacemaker provides an easy to use DJ app for all DJs and gives you
instant access to millions of tracks and a simple sync to your Spotify and Apple Music playlists.
You can create mixes by selecting track by track or simply pick a playlist and let our AI DJ
(Automix) create a perfect seamless mix for you. If you want to edit your mix in detail, enter the
studio: Zoom in and crop the beginning and the end of tracks, set the mix on more precise levels –
phrase, bar and beat.

### Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter (PICC): Building a Safe, Precise, and Efficient
### "Lifeline" — 2026 Global PICC Product and Technology Frontiers

In clinical settings such as oncology chemotherapy, long-term parenteral nutrition, intensive care,
and prolonged antibiotic therapy, establishing a safe and reliable central venous access is often
directly linked to patient outcomes and quality of life. The Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter
(PICC), owing to its minimally invasive nature, safety profile, and bedside operability, is
increasingly becoming the first-line choice for intravenous therapy.

][208]
[
June 30 2026

### Cardiovascular Interventional Products: Innovation and Breakthroughs Reshaping the Industry

Cardiovascular disease remains one of the most significant global health threats. In China,
approximately 330 million people suffer from cardiovascular diseases, including about 11.39 million
with coronary artery disease (CAD). Amid accelerating population aging and the widespread adoption
of minimally invasive therapeutic concepts, cardiovascular interventional products are evolving at
an unprecedented pace. From the “leave nothing behind” strategy of drug-coated balloons to
breakthroughs in intravascular lithotripsy (IVL), from the approval of the first domestically
developed interventional artificial heart to the clinical deployment of vascular interventional
surgical robots, a series of milestones indicate that cardiovascular interventional therapy has
entered a brand-new phase. Simultaneously, volume-based procurement (VBP) policies continue to
reshape the industry landscape, domestic substitution is accelerating, and the cardiovascular
intervention sector is moving from “data prosperity” towards “value creation”.

### Cardiovascular Interventional Products: Innovation and Breakthroughs Reshaping the Industry

Cardiovascular disease remains one of the most significant global health threats. In China,
approximately 330 million people suffer from cardiovascular diseases, including about 11.39 million
